questions.prompt: Which explorer is credited with reaching India by sea from Europe in 1498?
questions.fact: His sea route round Africa broke the overland spice monopoly and redirected European trade for centuries.

questions.prompt: What is the main cause of ocean tides on Earth?
questions.fact: The Moon pulls the ocean into a bulge on the near side, and an equal one on the far side — which is why most coasts get two high tides a day.

questions.prompt: Which cue sport is played on a table and can include red and colored balls?
questions.fact: A snooker table holds 15 reds and six colours. A maximum break of 147 means potting them in a near-perfect alternating sequence.

questions.prompt: Which video game series is set in the kingdom of Hyrule?
questions.fact: Hyrule's landscape came from creator Shigeru Miyamoto's childhood memories of exploring caves and hillsides near Kyoto.

questions.prompt: Which island nation sits in the North Atlantic near the Arctic Circle?
questions.fact: Iceland straddles the boundary between two tectonic plates, which is why it has so many volcanoes and heats almost all its buildings geothermally.

questions.prompt: What is Sherlock Holmes's famous London address?
questions.fact: No 221B existed when Conan Doyle invented it. The address later became real enough that a bank had to employ someone to answer Holmes's mail.

questions.prompt: What is a ZIP file commonly used for?
questions.fact: A ZIP shrinks files by replacing repeated patterns with shorter references, which is why text compresses dramatically and photos barely compress at all.
